preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)
Attacker must hold some amount of the CoinToken to execute transfers

exploit_hint: As owner, set tax wallets to attacker-controlled addresses, then manipulate buy/sell taxes to high values. Execute trades through Uniswap pair to generate tax revenue that gets sent to attacker wallets. Alternatively, blacklist other users to prevent them from selling while owner dumps tokens. Use setBuyTax() and setSellTax() to set extremely high taxes (up to 100%), then setTaxWallets() to attacker addresses. Trigger trades to collect fees in BNB.
